description: Send the geometry as base64 bytes. Quotes need it — a job with no file waits for one. Accepts STL, 3MF, OBJ, STEP, IGES, PLY, DXF, SVG, images and PDF. Up to 10 files, 50MB each. We will not fetch a URL for you; send the bytes.
